resources.string: Your memories from this day will show up here.
Every day, PhotoSwipe shows you the photos and videos you took on the same day in previous years, so you can keep the ones you love and clear out the rest.
To find them, the app needs access to your photos and videos.
Nothing leaves your phone: the app has no internet access, and nothing is deleted without your confirmation.
Access to your photos is needed
PhotoSwipe can\'t show your memories without access to your photos and videos. You can allow it at any time in the app settings.
